messages:
Emma (CS): Onboarding note: client 'LumenAI' reporting repeated 429s immediately after onboarding SDK. They only hit us from a single IP but across many browser tabs. Renewals team flagged.
Diego (SDK Eng): Quick suspect: preflight fanout + ephemeral tokens with low TTL. Do we have their token policy?
Emma (CS): Dev shared: ephemeral TTL=8s, open multiple tabs during validation. Also no X-Client-Id header set.
Ruth (Solutions Eng): That aligns. Each tab does a preflight, creating concurrency and triggering account-level throttles. Immediate mitigation: ask them to set stable X-Client-Id per user session and increase TTL to >=45s.
Diego (SDK Eng): I'll prepare a tiny SDK snip to default ephemeral TTL to 30s during onboarding windows. Also recommend connection reuse and a 100ms preflight batch window to collapse near-simultaneous checks.
Ops Bot: entitlement created: onboarding-preflight-grace:lumenai duration=20m by Ruth.
Emma (CS): I told LumenAI to hold on tab-spawning and applied the grace. Call set in 15m.
Ruth (Solutions Eng): Server-side option: bump handshake cache for that account to 90s for a short window. I'll add audit log and revert marker.
Diego (SDK Eng): Follow-up items: 1) patch SDK onboarding defaults (PR), 2) docs note: "avoid rotating tokens <30s during onboarding", 3) console alert card for "onboarding preflight 429" for CS.
Emma (CS): Thanks all. Will update this thread after the call and attach HAR if it persists. :thumbsup:
